note: Items that could NOT be confirmed from an official source, or project assumptions that are not official NFL values. Per project rules these are left blank in tables and published here for review. Published on the site's 'Flagged for Review' page.

items.item: Sportsbook/market betting lines (spreads, totals, prop prices, moneylines) for 2026 Week 9 and historical close lines.
items.reason: The NFL does not publish betting odds; no official source exists. All market-line fields in this project are left BLANK.
items.impact: No closing-line-value (CLV) or 'beat the market' comparison is possible from official data; strategies are validated against our own originated lines only.

items.item: Standard -110 vig and 52.38% breakeven win rate used in validation gates and ROI math.
items.reason: This is a sportsbook market convention, not an NFL-published value. Used only as an explicitly labeled assumption in gate arithmetic.

items.item: Per-player games played (GP) on the 2026 player-stat leaders table.
items.reason: GP column was not rendered in the fetched view of the leaders table. Player game logs exist on nfl.com player profile pages but were not fetched per player in this session.
items.impact: QB prop lines use team games played as the denominator (assumption: QB played all team games). Flagged per prop row.

items.item: Team column on nfl.com player-stat leaders tables (Jacoby Brissett, Malik Willis 2026 team = null).
items.reason: Team column not rendered in fetched view; teams were confirmed only where another official nfl.com source stated them (team_source noted per row).

items.item: CHI at SEA, Week 8 MNF (2026-11-02, 8:15 PM ET) result.
items.reason: Game was still pending at the data cutoff (2026-11-02). Excluded from backtest and model inputs.

items.item: BAL Week 9 starting QB; MIA, PHI, AZ Week 9 starting QBs.
items.reason: Official nfl.com news (2026-11-01) reports Lamar Jackson to IR with a season-ending thumb injury; the named backup for Week 9 was not confirmed from an official source fetched this session. MIA/PHI/AZ starters are not identifiable from the fetched official pages.
items.impact: No BAL/MIA/PHI/AZ QB prop line originated; rows left blank.

items.item: NYG (Jaxson Dart), WAS (Jayden Daniels), MIN (Kyler Murray), TB (Baker Mayfield), ATL (Michael Penix Jr. vs Tua Tagovailoa competition) 2026 season passing totals.
items.reason: These players do not appear in the top-24 of the fetched 2026 leaders table, and their exact 2026 totals were not captured from an official page in this session. Team affiliation for Dart/Daniels/Murray/Mayfield is confirmed via the official nfl.com kickoff-weekend rosters article.
items.impact: Prop lines for these players use 2025 totals only, or are left blank where no verified 2026/2025 value exists; flagged per row.

items.item: Cross-game parlay legs treated as independent (correlation = 0); only same-game leg correlation is computed from verified data.
items.reason: No official source publishes cross-game outcome correlations; independence is a modeling assumption, flagged.

items.item: Home-field advantage is computed empirically from the 120 verified 2026 games (walk-forward in backtest; full-sample for Week 9 lines), not an NFL-published constant.
items.reason: The NFL does not publish an HFA value; ours is derived from official game results.

items.item: 2025 season game-level results were not collected; 2025 enters the model only at team-aggregate level (standings PF/PA over 17 games).
items.reason: Scope control for this session; team-level 2025 data is fully verified from the official standings page.

items.item: Injuries, weather, rest/travel, lineups, coaching changes, and motivational factors are NOT in the verified dataset and are NOT modeled.
items.reason: Not confirmable at scale from official sources in this session (only the Jackson IR item was confirmed and is applied as a flag).

items.item: One standings table cell per team (7th record column, e.g. DEN 2025 '5-0-0') and non-YDS/REC columns on rushing/receiving leaders tables were not label-mapped in the fetched views.
items.reason: Column headers were not rendered in the fetched markdown; values not recorded rather than guessed.

items.item: Sportsbook settlement rules for props (e.g., 'player must record X' definitions, void/refund rules) are not published by the NFL.
items.reason: No official NFL source; bet grading in this project uses only official game results (final scores) and official player stat totals.

items.item: Repo contained only README.md with a single line '# Own5' at session start (no description, no docs).
items.reason: Irregularity flagged in docs/repo-review.md; README rewritten as part of this project.

items.item: Viewer location context: South Korea. Sports betting in South Korea is restricted to government-run Sports Toto products; offshore/online sportsbooks are illegal there.
items.reason: This project is sports-data analytics and line origination only - it does not facilitate wagering. Past performance does not guarantee future results; bet only what you can afford to lose, and only where legal.
